decisionDependencies.role: Incumbent constraints and porting cost may not determine the greenfield target.
A candidate claim may not be embedded in a sealed parent or used as a settled premise.
The edited documents must discharge every prior finding, not merely the subset restated in prose.
latest is a resolver whose selected exact identity must be returned.
Candidate and sealed statuses must reflect checkable artifacts and current conformance.

conformanceClaims.claim: Every occurrence of C-1 wording was checked against the status of its containing section.
Every prior C3-A2 finding was rechecked at all known locations, including locations omitted from Agent 1's recheck.
Promoted incumbent measurements were checked for both construct validity and transportability to the greenfield target.

blockingFindings.finding: The replacement C-1 language is inside the full thesis paragraph marked SEALED while 04 correctly marks the same decision CANDIDATE. This immediately repeats Error 5 with better wording: an unreviewed candidate has again been promoted by its sealed summary before peer acknowledgement.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Either mark the full thesis CANDIDATE until C-1 closes or split the thesis into sealed text plus an explicitly inline CANDIDATE C-1 clause. Only after the binding C-1 artifact is accepted may both locations become SEALED in one edit.

blockingFindings.finding: 06 correctly says several artifacts live in user repositories, but SEALED text in 02 still calls baselines the only such artifact; steering/03 repeats it. C3-A2-04 was repaired in only one occurrence.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Use the producer-derived-identity distinction consistently in 02, 06, and steering/03.

blockingFindings.finding: Projection parity is now fixed, but the other half of C3-A2-07 remains: 06 says run addressing means latest ambiguity never arises while 02 deliberately defines latest as an ambiguous resolver that must return the exact ID selected.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: State that latest never becomes authority and every resolver returns its exact selected ID; do not claim the selection ambiguity is absent.

blockingFindings.finding: The traceability status counts still describe the pre-repair audit, including one contradiction, and the artifact table still stops at D9 v1.1 while new C-1, C-2, C-3, R-1, and D9 v1.2 artifacts are under review. Current status cannot be inferred from a historical count presented without an as-of label.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Label the old count as the first audit snapshot, add a current disposition table, and register every active/superseded artifact. Update 07 only after v1.2 or its successor passes peer review.

blockingFindings.finding: The evidence-promotion repair retains construct validity but drops the external-validity and representative-workload requirements from C3-A2-08. A measurement can validly measure the incumbent yet fail to transport to the target. The worked claim that startup is dominated by module/dependency resolution is Node/package-graph contingent while the greenfield host language and distribution form remain open; it cannot be SEALED as a universal cold-path premise without a target-specific transportability argument.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Require four fields for promoted evidence: target claim, construct validity, transportability/causal mechanism under named candidate targets, and representative workload. Recast the three catalog tiers as a design choice justified by bounded startup/isolation merits, or mark the module-resolution dominance premise candidate and target-specific. Reconcile 10's absolute statement that current-system measurements are not in architecture.

blockingFindings.finding: P-4 remains product-owned and open, yet 01's SEALED hard-constraint consequence already chooses a TypeScript semantic provider. Strategic TypeScript depth supports that candidate but does not silently constitute product sign-off on the provider investment.
blockingFindings.requiredCorrection: Either obtain product-owner sign-off and redefine P-4 as additional providers beyond TypeScript, or demote the TS-provider consequence to the P-4 candidate while retaining strategic TypeScript depth as sealed.

nonBlockingDrift.finding: The phrase semantics-first correction is stale after C-1 rejected any globally first tier; use predicate-required rich facts.
The header still says nothing here may constrain architecture; qualify this as no migration decision, consistent with the repaired evidence rule.

agent2Verdict.conclusion: Agent 1's zero-blocker recheck is rejected. Most repairs are directionally correct, but two prior findings were incompletely searched, Error 5 recurs in the SEALED thesis, promoted evidence lacks transportability, traceability is stale, and P-4 is simultaneously sealed and product-open.
